role_summary: Identify maintainability, edge-case, migration, query, and evidence-integrity failures, then specify the minimum schema guardrails preventing them.
recommendation: A wide table, unconstrained EAV, or registry-only import will conflate absence, semantics, and measurement basis; reject all three. Use constrained long-form claims, first-class evidence reviews, immutable provenance, exact scope/basis matching, and computed eligibility views—never a curator-set `score_eligible` flag.
why: Basil combines growth targets, trial treatments, injury thresholds, disease conditions, and operating conditions under nominally identical variables.
Lettuce and the registry show that limitations co-occur; NULL or a single evidence-status enum destroys necessary distinctions.
Exact observable and basis keys prevent lux/PPFD/DLI, field-capacity/VWC/raw-percent, and irrigation-water/nutrient-solution EC joins.
Immutable releases prevent revised documents and duplicated final summaries from silently changing established claims.
A guarded eligibility view contains query complexity while keeping normalized evidence auditable.
schema_sketch:
FAILURE MODES → GUARDRAILS
- Wide tables: every new criterion changes schema; NULL conflates unassessed with searched-no-evidence.
- Free EAV/JSON: numeric casts, units, claim semantics, and scopes become application conventions.
- Separate optimum/risk/experiment tables: facts get copied between tables and sources/scopes drift.
- Nullable scope: implementers interpret unreported cultivar/system/stage as universal.
- Registry-only gaps: basil and peppermint appear falsely complete.
- Deterministic Markdown extraction: basil's nested prose and repeated final summary create duplicates and wrong citations.
- Mutable current rows: document revisions make earlier dashboard decisions irreproducible.
- Manual eligibility booleans: evidence changes without recomputing the flag.

MINIMUM CORE DDL
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; -- required on every SQLite connection

CREATE TABLE kb_release(
  release_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  version TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(manifest_sha256)=64),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft','published')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE source_document(
  source_document_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(path,content_sha256)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE source_record(
  source_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  url TEXT,
  doi TEXT UNIQUE
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE crop(
  crop_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  korean_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  scientific_name TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_kind(
  kind_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  semantic_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(semantic_class IN
    ('growth_target','management','experiment','observed_response',
     'disease_risk','injury','danger','lethality','operating_condition','qualitative'))
) STRICT;
-- Seed distinct codes for growth optimum, base temperature, trial treatment,
-- disease-risk condition, injury threshold, danger threshold, operating target, etc.

CREATE TABLE observable(
  observable_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  quantity_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  basis_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(quantity_code,basis_code)
) STRICT;
-- Distinct rows are mandatory for lux, PPFD, DLI, VWC, percent field capacity,
-- raw sensor percent, irrigation-water EC, nutrient-solution EC, and soil-extract EC.

CREATE TABLE unit(
  unit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE observable_unit(
  observable_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES observable,
  unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES unit,
  PRIMARY KEY(observable_id,unit_id)
) STRICT;
-- Only explicit, dimension-preserving conversions may be whitelisted; originals remain stored.

CREATE TABLE criterion(
  criterion_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  observable_id INTEGER REFERENCES observable,
  requested_kind_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES claim_kind
) STRICT;
-- Examples: air_temperature_growth_target and air_temperature_injury_threshold
-- are separate criteria even though both reference air temperature.

CREATE TABLE evidence_status(
  status_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL
) STRICT;
-- Seed the registry vocabulary verbatim; statuses remain many-to-many.

CREATE TABLE evidence_review(
  release_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES kb_release,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop,
  criterion_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES criterion,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('searched_no_direct','evidence_found')),
  source_document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_document,
  source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(release_id,crop_id,criterion_id)
) STRICT;
-- No row means unassessed; searched_no_direct is an explicit reviewed fact.

CREATE TABLE evidence_review_status(
  release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  criterion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_status,
  PRIMARY KEY(release_id,crop_id,criterion_id,status_code),
  FOREIGN KEY(release_id,crop_id,criterion_id)
    REFERENCES evidence_review(release_id,crop_id,criterion_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE evidence_claim(
  claim_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop,
  criterion_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES criterion,
  kind_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES claim_kind,
  assertion_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(assertion_type IN ('numeric','qualitative')),
  statement_ko TEXT NOT NULL,
  review_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(review_state IN ('draft','reviewed','rejected')),
  supersedes_claim_id INTEGER REFERENCES evidence_claim
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_source(
  claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_claim,
  source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_record,
  source_document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_document,
  source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
  raw_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(claim_id,source_id,source_document_id,source_locator)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_status(
  claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_claim,
  status_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_status,
  PRIMARY KEY(claim_id,status_code)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_predicate(
  predicate_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_claim,
  and_group INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  term_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  observable_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  operator TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operator IN ('eq','lt','le','gt','ge','between')),
  value_low REAL NOT NULL,
  value_high REAL,
  unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  lower_inclusive INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(lower_inclusive IN (0,1)),
  upper_inclusive INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(upper_inclusive IN (0,1)),
  is_approximate INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_approximate IN (0,1)),
  duration_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(duration_state IN ('none','unknown','stated','instantaneous')),
  duration_seconds REAL,
  duration_original_literal TEXT,
  original_value_literal TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(claim_id,and_group,term_order),
  FOREIGN KEY(observable_id,unit_id) REFERENCES observable_unit,
  CHECK((operator='between' AND value_high IS NOT NULL AND value_low<=value_high)
     OR (operator<>'between' AND value_high IS NULL)),
  CHECK((duration_state='stated' AND duration_seconds>0 AND duration_original_literal IS NOT NULL)
     OR (duration_state<>'stated' AND duration_seconds IS NULL))
) STRICT;
-- Terms in one claim are conjunctive. RH >95%, night, and >=7.5 h therefore cannot
-- be flattened into a bare 95% threshold; alternatives become separate claims.

CREATE TABLE scope_dimension(
  dimension_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  required INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(required IN (0,1))
) STRICT;
-- Seed cultivar, cultivation_system, growth_stage, medium, measurement_method,
-- daypart, and sensor_location.

CREATE TABLE scope_value(
  scope_value_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scope_dimension,
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(value_class IN ('any','specific','unknown')),
  UNIQUE(dimension_code,code),
  UNIQUE(scope_value_id,dimension_code)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE claim_scope(
  claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_claim,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_value_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(claim_id,dimension_code,scope_value_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(scope_value_id,dimension_code)
    REFERENCES scope_value(scope_value_id,dimension_code)
) STRICT;
-- Release validation forbids mixing any/unknown with specific values. Unknown never matches;
-- it is not silently treated as universal.

CREATE TABLE claim_relation(
  parent_claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_claim,
  relation_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation_code IN ('recovery_of','duration_for','qualifies','derived_from')),
  child_claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_claim,
  PRIMARY KEY(parent_claim_id,relation_code,child_claim_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE guidance(
  guidance_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop,
  action_text_ko TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_document,
  source_locator TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE guidance_channel(
  guidance_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guidance,
  observable_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES observable,
  PRIMARY KEY(guidance_id,observable_id)
) STRICT;
-- Section 9 remains available when no numeric claim is eligible.

CREATE TABLE release_claim(
  release_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES kb_release,
  claim_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_claim,
  PRIMARY KEY(release_id,claim_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER release_claim_gate
BEFORE INSERT ON release_claim
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim_source s WHERE s.claim_id=NEW.claim_id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evidence_claim c
             WHERE c.claim_id=NEW.claim_id AND c.review_state<>'reviewed')
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evidence_claim c
             WHERE c.claim_id=NEW.claim_id AND c.assertion_type='numeric'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim_predicate p WHERE p.claim_id=c.claim_id))
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim_status cs
             WHERE cs.claim_id=NEW.claim_id AND cs.status_code='no_direct_evidence')
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scope_dimension d WHERE d.required=1
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim_scope s
                             WHERE s.claim_id=NEW.claim_id
                               AND s.dimension_code=d.dimension_code))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'claim lacks provenance, review, predicate, or explicit scope');
END;

CREATE VIEW review_coverage AS
SELECT r.release_id,c.crop_id,k.criterion_id,
       COALESCE(e.outcome,'unassessed') AS outcome
FROM kb_release r CROSS JOIN crop c CROSS JOIN criterion k
LEFT JOIN evidence_review e
  ON e.release_id=r.release_id AND e.crop_id=c.crop_id AND e.criterion_id=k.criterion_id;

DEPLOYMENT-LOCAL ESCAPE HATCH
CREATE TABLE deployment(
  deployment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE deployment_scope(
  deployment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES deployment,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_value_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(deployment_id,dimension_code),
  FOREIGN KEY(scope_value_id,dimension_code)
    REFERENCES scope_value(scope_value_id,dimension_code)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE sensor_channel(
  channel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE sensor_binding(
  binding_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  deployment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES deployment,
  channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_channel,
  raw_observable_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  raw_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(raw_observable_id,raw_unit_id) REFERENCES observable_unit
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE deployment_calibration(
  calibration_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_binding,
  output_observable_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  output_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  model_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(model_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft','validated','retired')),
  valid_from TEXT NOT NULL,
  valid_to TEXT,
  validation_note TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(output_observable_id,output_unit_id) REFERENCES observable_unit
) STRICT;
-- Deliberately no claim_id or source_id: local calibration cannot become literature evidence.

COMPUTED ELIGIBILITY PREDICATE
A numeric suitability-input view may expose a claim only when: the release is published; kind.semantic_class='growth_target'; evidence_review.outcome='evidence_found'; crop matches; the effective sensor observable/basis matches exactly; every required scope is either any or an exact deployment match; unknown scope never matches; experimental_condition_only and general_crop_reference are absent; and measurement_not_transferable is accepted only with a validated deployment calibration plus exact medium/method scope. Cultivar-, system-, and stage-specific claims require exact matches. Risk, injury, danger, experiment, and operating-condition claims go to advisory views, not this view.

An alarm-readiness view must additionally require a risk/injury/danger claim, no not_a_risk_threshold status, directly sourced stated/instantaneous duration, a recovery_of claim, and a matching sensor observable. Missing duration or recovery therefore produces advisory-only output rather than an invented default.

PIPELINE/RELEASE GUARDS
1. Hash Markdown and registry inputs into a draft release.
2. Deterministically extract headings, table cells, and source records only; treat trailing final summaries as duplicate-detection fixtures, not new evidence.
3. Human-review semantic kind, predicate, basis, scope, and citations in a versioned structured manifest.
4. Populate evidence_review for the MVP criterion matrix across all eight crops, deriving basil and peppermint gaps from their inline markers.
5. Publish only after validation rejects missing provenance/scope, contradictory statuses, incomplete eight-crop coverage, or duplicate source locators.
6. Revisions append a new release and superseding claims; published releases are immutable. Raw documents remain evidence sources, the reviewed manifest is semantic source of truth, and SQLite is a reproducible derived artifact.
scorable_axes: air temperature — conditionally scorable only from direct growth-target claims with exact crop and ambient-air scope; trials and injury thresholds remain separate.
soil temperature — conditionally scorable only when growth stage, medium, and soil/substrate basis exactly match direct evidence.
unscorable_axes: air humidity — crop growth optima are generally absent; disease-risk RH thresholds are advisory, not suitability targets.
illuminance/light (lux) — the corpus uses PPFD, DLI, or sunlight duration, with no validated spectrum-specific conversion.
CO2 concentration — the isolated basil interaction experiment supplies no crop-specific target range.
particulate matter/air quality — the corpus contains no horticultural threshold.
noise level — it is neither evidenced nor a recognized crop-growth axis here.
soil moisture — field-capacity ratios, system-specific VWC, and generic sensor percentages are incomparable without validated local calibration.
assumptions: SQLite 3.37+ is available and every connection enables foreign keys.
The team can human-review extracted claims; deterministic parsing alone is insufficient.
Deployment crop, stage, system, medium, and calibration metadata will eventually be supplied.
risks: Normalization and release triggers may consume hackathon time or tempt developers to bypass the safe views.
The controlled taxonomy can still encode curator mistakes, especially when Korean prose mixes recommendation and observation.
Hash-based provenance is exact but line locators become inconvenient after document revisions.
cheap_validation: Load one in-memory SQLite fixture containing basil 25–30℃ growth target, 35℃ trial response, RH 85% disease risk, PPFD 500, field-capacity 70%, and explicit missing-RH-optimum review; run the eligibility view once and assert that only air temperature is returned for uncalibrated hardware.
change_mind_if: I would abandon this constrained relational approach if that fixture cannot represent the compound night-RH-duration condition and field-capacity mismatch without crop-specific SQL or free-text exceptions.
